candidates.title: Estimator - Infrastructure
candidates.content_text: BildGroup careers board (verified 4 Oct 2026). Estimator role, Civil Construction/Engineering, Permanent, On site, Campbellfield VIC HQ. Permanent full time, office based at Campbellfield. Work across the Infrastructure division’s tenders rather than sitting on a single project. Direct line to the General Manager, Infrastructure. Income protection and EAP. BildUp learning platform and Bild Leadership Program. Contact published on careers browse page: 1300 471 822, info@bild.group. No junior or graduate estimator listing on the current board; this is an open Estimator vacancy at the Melbourne north HQ (Campbellfield), close to Melton corridors.
candidates.apply_instructions: Apply via BildGroup careers board listing for Estimator Campbellfield; general contact info@bild.group / 1300 471 822 published on the careers page.
